none: PAS SUSS-2C5195: Roman copper alloy as of unclear empress, possibly Faustina II (AD 161-180)
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy as, probably of Faustina II, struck under Marcus Aurelius and dating to the period AD 161 to 175. Juno reverse type but legend is unclear. Mint of Rome. cf. RIC III, p. 345, no. 1647, 1648 or 1652
